caption_L1: Here a is a bar diagram called Estimated Gross Domestic Product of small businesses and large businesses in the United States in 2010 , by industry (in million U.S. dollars). The y-axis shows Large business GDP with linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 1,400,000 while the x-axis shows industry as categorical scale starting at Accommodation and Food Service and ending at Whosesale & Retail Trade.
caption_L2L3: Mining and manufacturing had the highest GDP of nearly $1,400,000. Arts and entertainment, and other including Government services had the lowest GDP spending. Finance and insurance spent $1 million dollars on GDP.
